description: Validate a Colombian NIT with the DIAN check-digit algorithm and look it up live in the RUES commercial registry kept by the chambers of commerce (Confecámaras open data on datos.gov.co, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0). Returns the computed check digit, legal name, registration status (active, cancelled and others), last renewal year, registration dates, chamber of commerce, legal form, CIIU activity codes and a pass/review/fail assessment with reasons. This is the commercial registry, not DIAN tax status. For individuals only the check digit and registration status are returned, without name or address.

nit.description: Colombian NIT with or without the check digit, e.g. "899999068-1" or "899999068". Dots and spaces are ignored.

name: validate_colombia_nit
title: Validate Colombia NIT (tax ID)
